sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy remains the undisputed market leader as the sole "all-green" sector, while Technology and Financials push higher amid fading momentum in Basic Materials and Healthcare.

Energy continues to dominate the US equity landscape, standing as the only sector out of 11 to achieve all-green status across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD) with a leading momentum score of 0.87. Technology (momentum 0.78) and Financials (momentum 0.68) are rotating upward, each gaining one spot in rank over the past five sessions to reach ranks 2 and 7, respectively.

Conversely, defensive and cyclical areas are showing signs of fatigue. Basic Materials and Healthcare, despite possessing relatively strong momentum scores of 0.67, both slipped one spot in rank over the last five sessions. Utilities remains the deepest laggard with a weak momentum score of 0.13, followed closely by Consumer Defensive at 0.27.

## Strength
* **Energy Dominance:** Energy is the sole "all-green" sector across all timeframes, holding the #1 YTD rank with a dominant momentum score of 0.87 (0.867).
* **Technology Resilience:** Technology securely holds the #2 YTD rank with a strong momentum score of 0.78 (0.783), gaining +1 spot in rank over the last five sessions.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Rank Gainers:** Technology (+1 spot, rank 2), Industrials (+1 spot, rank 4), Financials (+1 spot, rank 7), and Communication Services (+1 spot, rank 9) led the short-term rank improvements.
* **Entrenched Laggards:** Utilities (momentum 0.13, rank 10) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.27, rank 8) continue to anchor the bottom of the momentum curve, with both dropping -1 spot in rank over the last five sessions.
* **Cyclical Bottom:** Consumer Cyclical remains flat at the very bottom of the YTD rankings (rank 11) with a weak momentum score of 0.33.

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Basic Materials (momentum 0.67) and Healthcare (momentum 0.67) are showing early signs of weakness, both dropping -1 spot in rank over the last five sessions despite their high overall momentum scores.
* **Low-Momentum Rank Gains:** Communication Services gained +1 spot to reach rank 9 despite a weak momentum score of 0.33, indicating a minor relative rotation among lagging sectors.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and industrial services maintain dominant leadership, while software and coal groups make aggressive short-term gains amid a sharp pullback in textiles and retail.

Market breadth remains highly concentrated, with only 16 of 144 industry groups achieving "all-green" status across all timeframes. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.970) and Staffing & Employment Services (momentum 0.876) continue to lead the charge. Rotation is highly visible in Software - Infrastructure, which jumped 25 spots to rank 59, and Coking Coal, which climbed 24 spots to rank 39 with strong 0.857 momentum.

Conversely, cyclical and consumer-facing segments are fading rapidly. Textile Manufacturing tumbled 34 spots to rank 67, while Specialty Retail dropped 25 spots to rank 100. Consumer discretionary laggards like Footwear & Accessories (momentum 0.041) and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.110) remain anchored at the bottom of the YTD rankings.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 11.1% (16 of 144) of industry groups maintain all-green status, indicating a highly concentrated market leadership.
* **Energy Dominance:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads all groups with a momentum score of 0.970 (YTD rank 2), supported by Oil & Gas Equipment & Services (momentum 0.83).
* **Sustained Leaders:** Staffing & Employment Services (momentum 0.88), Health Information Services (momentum 0.87), and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.86) remain highly resilient across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Software - Infrastructure surged 25 spots to rank 59 (momentum 0.75), while Thermal Coal rallied 23 spots to rank 63 (momentum 0.75).
* **Sharp Decliners:** Textile Manufacturing plummeted 34 spots to rank 67 (momentum 0.20), and Specialty Retail dropped 25 spots to rank 100 (momentum 0.22).
* **Momentum Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories (0.041), Airports & Air Services (0.110), and Resorts & Casinos (0.112) continue to anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Groups:** Gold (momentum 0.61) and Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.67) are showing early fatigue, losing 9 and 4 spots respectively over the last 5 days.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Education & Training Services (+15 spots, rank 86, momentum 0.46) and Aerospace & Defense (+11 spots, momentum 0.45) are rising in rank despite currently low momentum scores.
* **Resource Rotation:** While Coking Coal surged 24 spots, broader resource groups like Other Industrial Metals & Mining and Oil & Gas Integrated slipped by 4 and 3 spots respectively.
